design_system_tokens.theme: Uber-inspired High-Contrast Modern Tech & Creative (Light Base with Stark Obsidian Dark Accents)

scale.display: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-[1.05]
scale.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-[1.1]
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-[1.15]
scale.caption: text-xs font-medium text-slate-500
scale.mono_label: overline font-mono text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-semibold text-slate-500

border_radii.pill: rounded-full (9999px for interactive primary buttons, search chips, category badges)
border_radii.card: rounded-xl (12px or 16px for service cards, job feeds, dialogs)
border_radii.input: rounded-lg (8px for form fields, select triggers)
border_radii.sharp: rounded-none (for brutalist layout frames and split bars)

buttons.primary: bg-black text-white hover:bg-neutral-800 rounded-full px-6 py-3.5 font-medium transition-all duration-200 active:scale-[0.98] shadow-sm flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-base
buttons.secondary: bg-neutral-100 text-black hover:bg-neutral-200 rounded-full px-6 py-3.5 font-medium transition-all duration-200 active:scale-[0.98] flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-base
buttons.accent: bg-[#276EF1] text-white hover:bg-[#1E58C8] rounded-full px-6 py-3.5 font-medium transition-all duration-200 shadow-sm flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-base
buttons.ghost: bg-transparent text-black hover:bg-neutral-100 rounded-full px-4 py-2.5 font-medium transition-colors text-sm

inputs.default: w-full bg-neutral-50 border border-neutral-300 focus:border-black focus:bg-white focus:ring-1 focus:ring-black rounded-lg px-4 py-3 text-base text-black placeholder:text-neutral-400 transition-all outline-none

cards.service_tile: group relative bg-white border border-neutral-200 rounded-xl p-5 hover:border-black hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 cursor-pointer flex flex-col justify-between overflow-hidden
cards.dashboard_widget: bg-white border border-neutral-200 rounded-xl p-6 shadow-sm hover:border-neutral-300 transition-all
cards.dark_banner: bg-black text-white rounded-2xl p-8 sm:p-12 relative overflow-hidden

homepage.hero_structure: Uber-style split screen: Left side floating request card (Service picker + Address input + Instant Dispatch CTA), Right side dynamic hero imagery (curated courier/mechanic/handyman photo with high contrast black gradient vignette).
homepage.service_grid: 30+ Categories categorized under 4 primary pillars (Road & Auto, Home Maintenance, Logistics & Moving, Personal & Professional). Displayed as clean high-density tiles with bold mono badges and subtle hover lift.
homepage.how_it_works: 3-step visual narrative (1. Pick & Detail -> 2. Instant Match & Live GPS -> 3. Complete & Rate). Clean numeric steps with high legibility monospace counters.
homepage.trust_markers: P2P Verified Providers, Upfront 10% Deposit Protection, Real-time GPS Tracking, 4.9/5 Average Rating.

order_flow.step_1_category: Visual service grid with price estimates & speed tags ('Under 20 min dispatch').
order_flow.step_2_details: Category-specific questions in neat stacked inputs with clear label hierarchy and image attachment option.
order_flow.step_3_dispatch: Uber-style address auto-complete + date/time picker (Instant or Scheduled) + clear 10% deposit breakdown.
order_flow.step_4_live_tracker: Full-bleed interactive map layout with provider avatar, ETA counter, live status bar (Dispatched -> En Route -> Arrived -> In Progress), and instant call/chat drawer.

provider_dashboard.job_feed: Split view: Left list of available jobs sorted by live distance + earnings payout. Right map showing job markers with dispatch radii.
provider_dashboard.earnings_summary: Clean stat widgets displaying Today's Earnings, Active Deposit Balance, Completed Jobs Count, and Stripe Instant Payout button.
provider_dashboard.online_toggle: Uber-style top bar toggle switch ('YOU ARE ONLINE' with animated green indicator pulse).

marketing_template.hero: Bold editorial headline (Space Grotesk, 56px) + concise subhead + pill CTAs + high-impact full-width photo or split visual.
marketing_template.content_sections: Asymmetrical 2-column feature blocks with clean typography, icon grids, and stat counters.
marketing_template.final_cta: Full-bleed Obsidian Black banner with high-contrast White CTA button ('Get Started on Lumo').

navbar.style: Sticky top bar with crystal glass blur (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 border-b border-neutral-200 z-50 px-4 sm:px-8 py-3.5)
navbar.guest: Lumo Logo + 'Services', 'How it Works', 'For Providers', 'Marketplace' + 'Log In' (ghost button) + 'Get Started' (black pill button)
navbar.customer: Lumo Logo + 'Book Service', 'My Orders', 'Marketplace', 'Wallet' + Customer Avatar dropdown
navbar.provider: Lumo Logo + 'Job Feed', 'Earnings', 'Wallet', 'Community Market' + Online/Offline status badge + Provider Profile
navbar.admin: Lumo Logo + 'User Management', 'Listings & Jobs', 'Affiliates', 'System Logs' + Admin Badge

footer.style: Deep Obsidian Black background (#000000) with stark white text, generous padding (py-20), multi-column links, city index, app download buttons, and copyright statement.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Uber-inspired design system: bold black and white palette, minimal blue accent (#276EF1), Space Grotesk headers, IBM Plex Sans body, IBM Plex Mono overlines.
Implement pill-shaped buttons (rounded-full) for all primary actions and search triggers.
Preserve all existing routes, React 19 architecture, and data-testid attributes for reliable testing.
Ensure every page and component is fully mobile-first and responsive.
Apply subtle hover interactions (active scale 0.98, border-color transitions, light shadow elevations) across all service cards and buttons.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid: MUST include data-testid attribute on all interactive buttons, inputs, links, cards, tabs, and modals.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_gradients_of_doom: Avoid bright multi-color background gradients. Stick to solid white, crisp light gray (#F6F6F6), or deep obsidian black (#000000).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.typography_rules: Headings use Space Grotesk with negative tracking (-0.02em). Micro labels use IBM Plex Mono uppercase overline with letter-spacing 0.2em.
